$Comment: The yearly feast: once the questline is done, bring the host a pumpkin pie, some cooked meat and
carrots, and sit down to the feast. Its pay holds that year's keepsake, a plate with the year on
it, collected with the rest at the host. The first Claim row is the plate: StackNameArg @run reads
as the label of the Harvest Feast run this quest is paid for, which for a yearly event is its year,
is stamped into every plate handed over and read back from the item, so never rename that key.
Finishing it also earns that year's keepsake achievement, harvest_feast_keepsake, for its points.
Repeat.PerRun brings this one quest back once in each year's run of Harvest Feast: a run pays it
once, a forced or moved run cannot pay it twice, and a feast left unfinished when the run ends waits
for next year and counts for that year's run. The steps before it never come back. Everything here
is handed in at the host, so no report-back step is added.
The two Mmo_Xp rows are MMO Skill Tree's: Crafting XP for the cooking and Harvesting XP for the
carrots, waiting to be collected with the rest. Each row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed
gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: The_Feast
